changes.title: Blood trails
items: Hurt animals leave little dark-red footprints (and the badly hurt, drips) that fade after a few seconds; healing stops them

changes.title: Heal pluses
items: Green + signs float up off an animal whenever it is healed: a berry, invited, leashed, or a happy legend mending (one small + every second or two)

changes.title: Relic bottles
items: The giant party bottles now lie in the forest where a relic waits, half-buried and glowing in their own colour
